Alger, 14 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 14, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Samsung is preparing the early launch of the One UI 9.5 update on its Galaxy S26 smartphones. Based on Android 17, this redesigned interface will offer new features guided by artificial intelligence, including a revamped Bixby voice assistant.
Samsung s'apprête à lancer le programme: Samsung is getting ready to launch the One UI 9.5 beta program for its Galaxy S26 lineup, shortly after the rollout of the stable version of One UI 9 in mid-September. According to elements detected on the manufacturer's internal servers and claims from leaker Fahad Ali Javed, the opening of this testing phase is imminent. Estimates place this availability around the third week of the current month, three weeks ahead of the usual annual schedule.
Toujours structurée autour du système An: Still structured around the Android 17 system, the update brings visible ergonomic changes. The main action buttons within the brand's native applications are being moved to the bottom of the screen. This modification aims to facilitate one-handed use on large devices such as the Galaxy S26 Ultra.
Nouvelles fonctionnalités d'IA et évolut: New AI features and the evolution of Bixby
La principale innovation logicielle de c: The main software innovation in this version lies in the application named Memory. Accessible with a three-finger swipe, this tool makes it possible to group various contents such as screenshots, voice notes, and web pages in one place. The integrated artificial intelligence is then responsible for organizing, sorting, and generating summaries of this saved data.
En parallèle, l'assistant Bixby gagne en: At the same time, the Bixby assistant gains autonomy by directly relying on the information contained in the Memory application. It becomes capable of executing complex tasks without requiring validation at every step, such as booking a hotel or ordering everyday consumer products.
Ces nouveautés demeurent pour le moment: These new features are currently only observed in test versions, and Samsung has not yet published an official announcement regarding the final stable rollout schedule.
One UI 9.5 reposera sur Android 17 et po: One UI 9.5 will be based on Android 17 and could arrive in public beta three weeks ahead of the usual schedule.
